name: PeerTube
description: Federated video hosting platform that shares bandwidth between instances using peer-to-peer streaming.

envVars.description: Public hostname the instance is served from
Application secret used to sign sessions

composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      PEERTUBE_DB_HOSTNAME: "{{serviceName}}-postgres"
      PEERTUBE_DB_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
      PEERTUBE_REDIS_HOSTNAME: "{{serviceName}}-redis"
      PEERTUBE_WEBSERVER_HOSTNAME: {{env.PEERTUBE_WEBSERVER_HOSTNAME}}
      PEERTUBE_SECRET: {{env.PEERTUBE_SECRET}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/data:/data
      - {{appDataPath}}/config:/config
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-postgres
      - {{serviceName}}-redis
  {{serviceName}}-postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-postgres
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: peertube
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
      POSTGRES_DB: peertube
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data
  {{serviceName}}-redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-redis
    restart: unless-stopped
